artifacts.name: research-analysis
artifacts.description: Full research analysis covering 3D rendering options, brick mechanics, snap-to-grid systems, competitive landscape, recommended tech stack, risks, and phased architecture direction for the browser-based Lego Builder app.

summary.work_completed: Researched browser-based 3D Lego builder landscape. Analyzed competitive products (Mecabricks, BrickLink Studio, LDD), open-source references (three-lego, LDraw.js, voxel.js), and evaluated Three.js vs Babylon.js vs raw WebGL. Produced comprehensive research_analysis.md with tech stack recommendation, architecture direction, and phased delivery plan.
key_findings: No dominant open-source browser-native Lego builder exists — genuine greenfield opportunity
Three.js + @react-three/fiber is the recommended rendering stack (performance, ecosystem, community)
InstancedMesh + three-mesh-bvh are critical for performance at scale (1000+ bricks)
Snap-to-grid via occupancy Map + raycasting is the proven pattern from Minecraft-clone references
Zustand + Immer command pattern recommended for brick state and undo/redo

human_review_required.reason: Official Lego part geometry may have licensing implications for commercial use. Legal review recommended before v2 LDraw integration.
These features significantly expand backend requirements. PM should confirm MVP scope before architecture is finalized.
